current_phase: Phase-1A-11 unified research direction and audit
research_direction: Core target: LLM-empowered evolutionary computation is to be applied to improving this repository's own Agent Evolution Sandbox (AES). Track A audits whether LLM/Agent can propose verifiably better EC mechanisms; Track B audits AES readiness and establishes fair EC baselines. Application to Agent is a fixed research objective, but performance benefit and cross-domain transfer remain empirical hypotheses. Bidirectional feedback is conditional on independent evidence for both directions.
